model_annotation: This chart is a nested donut (ring) chart consisting of two concentric rings that represent two different measures of ambiguity: the outer ring displays "Ambiguity Std" and the inner ring displays "Max Ambiguity." The outer ring contains four slices corresponding to different standard deviation values: "Std: 0.0" shown in a very dark navy/teal color at 7.0%, "Std: 0.47" shown in a dark teal color at 47.7%, "Std: 0.82" shown in a medium blue color at 49.0% (appearing as the largest or near-largest segment on the left side), and "Std: 0.94" shown in a bright cyan/light blue color at 5.0%. The inner ring contains three slices representing maximum ambiguity levels: "Max: 1" in a medium sky blue at 38.0%, "Max: 2" in a lighter cyan blue at 39.0%, and "Max: 3" in a very pale light blue at 14.2%. Percentage labels are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice within both rings. Two separate legends are provided to the right of the chart, one for each ring, with color swatches clearly distinguishing the categories. The segments in the outer ring do not appear to follow a strictly descending order by size when read clockwise, nor do those in the inner ring, suggesting the arrangement may follow the categorical ordering of the standard deviation and maximum values rather than proportional size.
